label: NieR
about: NieR Mode's own six ink scenes, drawn from the same art as its Background setting (Concepts/onboarding/opus-5.5/src/settings/nier/scenes, by tools/nier_prints.mjs), ink on parchment and parchment on ink, as faint as NieR Mode shows them. Jared, 2026-10-14 (#11): these replace Archive, Signal, Fragments, Hatch and Flora.

wallpapers.name: City Ruins
wallpapers.description: Toppled towers, broken walkways and the trees that took them back.

wallpapers.name: The Bunker
wallpapers.description: The orbital base: a hexagon shell around the command deck, a star-shaped beacon above it.

wallpapers.name: Desert
wallpapers.description: Half-buried housing blocks and broken arches in the dunes, under a pale sun.

wallpapers.name: Forest Castle
wallpapers.description: A castle on the hill above a forest that hides the old roads.

wallpapers.name: Amusement Park
wallpapers.description: A big wheel, a coaster loop and the big top, with fireworks over them.

wallpapers.name: Flooded City
wallpapers.description: Leaning towers standing in still water, a small boat between them.
